name: Anchor Ingredients - Corporate Office
old_description: At Anchor Ingredients, we are the trusted link from the farm to finished foods, providing ultimate connectivity throughout the entire supply chain. With exceptional products, a relentless attention to detail and proactive customer support, we’re committed to ensuring your brand’s success.
about:
Anchor Ingredients is a privately owned specialty ingredient supplier headquartered in Fargo, North Dakota. Established as a link between agricultural producers and food brands, the company has grown into a coast-to-coast network with offices, manufacturing facilities, and warehouses across the United States.

The company provides a range of soil-to-shelf services including farm-level ingredient sourcing, custom processing, freeze-dry co-manufacturing, blending, logistics, and distribution. Its portfolio spans conventional and organic ingredients for both human and pet food markets, supported by multiple processing facilities nationwide.

Anchor serves brands in the pet food and human food industries, offering supply chain management and co-manufacturing partnerships. Customers include food manufacturers seeking traceable, premium ingredients and integrated logistics solutions.

Founded on a mission to cultivate connectivity and quality across the food supply chain, Anchor emphasizes transparency, traceability, and sustainability. The company highlights its stringent supplier approval program, in-house testing validated by third parties, and a digital portal that provides certificates of analysis and traceability reports for every order.

name: Anco Equipment
old_description: I have been in the food & dairy processing equipment industry for over 17 years and founded Anco Equipment almost 13 years ago. I take pride seeing my customers business grow using my equipment. When I am not working you can find me at the golf course, in the woods, or hanging out with my wife on our hobby farm.
about:
Anco Equipment is based in Pulaski, Wisconsin. The company was founded by Trevor Anderson, who brought 17 years of experience in the food and dairy processing equipment industry, approximately 13 years ago. His wife, Rebecca Anderson, joined as co-owner, having grown up in the dairy equipment business through her father, Fran Ullmer.

Anco Equipment designs and manufactures stainless steel processing equipment, including mixing tanks, pasteurizers, homogenizers, cheese vats, butter churns, milk silos, and clean-out-of-place wash tanks. The equipment is built from 304 and 316 stainless steel for heating, cooling, storing, mixing, and aging products. The company collaborates with experienced engineers to provide start-to-finish solutions.

The company serves the food, dairy, beverage, cosmetic, and chemical processing industries. Its customer base includes major brands such as Coca-Cola, Starbucks, Unilever, Godiva Chocolate, and McDonald's.

Anderson founded the company to provide high-quality, detail-oriented equipment that helps customers grow their businesses. Anco emphasizes a pragmatic approach, safety compliance, and start-to-finish engineering support.

name: Anderson Woodwork's LLC furniture & cabinet,s
old_description: and build custom furniture, collector pieces, and studio line furniture for homeowners, collectors, and designers who want something real—furniture with presence, intention, and longevity. Every piece that leaves my shop is made by hand, using traditional joinery and carefully selected hardwoods, right here in Washington State.
about:
Anderson Woodworks is a one-person woodworking shop based in Yelm, Washington, founded by Brian Anderson. An Olympia-area native, Anderson spent roughly twelve years in custom home building before opening his own shop, applying that experience to furniture and cabinetry that must live in real houses.

The shop produces custom furniture, cabinetry, and built-ins entirely by hand using traditional joinery. Offerings include dining tables, desks, consoles, kitchen and vanity cabinets, library systems, and one-of-a-kind collector pieces featuring hand-cut dovetails, mortise-and-tenon joints, and marquetry inlay. All work is built in Anderson’s Yelm shop; he handles design, fabrication, and delivery, while installation is left to the client’s contractor.

Anderson serves homeowners, collectors, and designers throughout the South Sound region—Olympia, Lacey, Tumwater, Tacoma, Gig Harbor, and Thurston and Pierce Counties. Collector pieces are shipped nationally. The business also provides furniture-led interior design consultations, including space planning, material selection, and full-room design packages that integrate custom pieces.

Anderson emphasizes that his joinery methods—hand-cut dovetails and mortise-and-tenon—are the same techniques that have kept furniture standing for centuries. He positions the shop as an alternative to mass-produced, fastener-dependent furniture, offering direct collaboration with the maker and a design philosophy rooted in longevity rather than trends.

name: Anglims Western Metalworks Inc
old_description: was started in 1981 as family-owned business founded by Clyde and Sandy Buckelew. Beginning as a one-man shop operating out of a garage, it grew and expanded to take on a wider variety of clients and jobs…
about:
Anglims Western Metalworks Inc. operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico. The business was founded in 1981 by Clyde and Sandy Buckelew as a family-owned venture that began in a garage as a one-man shop. Over the decades it expanded to serve a broader range of clients and projects.

The company provides metal fabrication and welding services, including CNC cutting, shearing, 5-axis waterjet cutting (via a Maxiem 1530 machine), machining, tube forming, and metal sign production. Work is performed in-house, with on-site fabrication and welding available for projects that cannot be transported. The shop handles materials such as steel, stainless steel, aluminum, and sheet metal, and its welders are experienced in MIG, TIG, and stick processes.

Customers span agriculture, clean-room technology, government and public utilities, healthcare, manufacturing, mining, restaurants, and facility support. Past and current clients include PNM, the General Electric Airplane Engine Plant, Motorola, Intel, Rio Grande Concrete Plant, Sandia National Laboratories, New Mexico Air Force bases, and local farmers and dairymen.

The Anglims, who purchased the business in 2010, emphasize attention to detail, precise craftsmanship, and fair dealing. The firm highlights its skilled tradesmen, decades of experience, and a reputation for completing projects on schedule with quality welds that are both strong and visually seamless.

name: Ango Electronics Corporation
old_description: Since 2005, AnTek has been dedicated to providing reliable products, competitive prices, and exceptional service — supporting everyone from hobbyists to large-scale manufacturers with dependable power solutions.
about:
AnTek Inc. was established in 2005 in North Arlington, New Jersey, just minutes from New York City. The company began as a specialist in toroidal transformers for audio and CNC applications.

The company designs and manufactures high-quality toroidal transformers, and has expanded its line to include tube amplifier power transformers, toroidal output transformers in single-ended and push-pull configurations, and steel powder-coated amplifier chassis. It also produces a full range of unregulated power supplies built for high-current, cost-effective performance, suitable for solenoids, relays, DC motors, stepper motors, servo systems, DC-DC converters, and battery chargers.

AnTek serves customers ranging from part-time DIY builders to professional audio and electronics manufacturers. Its components are used in audio equipment, CNC machinery, and industrial automation systems such as motor drives and power conversion units.

The company states its focus is on reliable products, competitive prices, and exceptional service, emphasizing precision, reliability, and performance. It offers a customer satisfaction guarantee and automatic bulk discounts on large orders.

about:
Apollo Electric was founded in 1995 by George Wasilewski in New York City. After moving from Poland, Wasilewski started a small residential electrical business with a vision rooted in reputation, trust, and long-term relationships. The company is headquartered in New York, New York, and remains founder-led.

The firm provides high-end electrical contracting services for luxury residential and commercial projects. Its scope includes installation, maintenance, and repair of electrical panels, lighting fixtures, wiring, and outlets, as well as integration of advanced lighting control systems such as Lutron HomeWorks QS, Eco-System, and wireless solutions. Apollo also installs EV charging infrastructure and audio-visual systems, and operates a dedicated 24/7 service division staffed by licensed master electricians. In-house accounting, coordination, and estimating departments support project execution across multiple states, with satellite offices in Florida, Connecticut, California (as AE Electric), Texas, and Nevada, plus a traveling team for national projects.

Apollo serves architects, developers, and general contractors in high-end single-family residential construction, luxury retail, hospitality, office, healthcare, and multifamily developments. Notable projects include the Porsche Tower Residences and flagship stores for Gucci, Celine, Rolex, and Tiffany & Co., as well as hospitality venues such as Four Seasons Restaurants, Carbone, Delilah, 40/40 Club, Eataly, and Catch.

The company was built on a vision of excellence and lasting relationships, emphasizing technical mastery, discretion, and craftsmanship. Its differentiators include round-the-clock service availability, integrated in-house project management divisions, and specialization in sophisticated lighting control and automation platforms.

about:
Appalachian Supply Inc. traces its roots to 1982 in Littleton, New Hampshire, where it began as a family-owned plumbing, heating, and electrical supply warehouse with an attached hardware store. Within a year the company opened a second location in St. Johnsbury, Vermont, which eventually became its primary operation. The business remains family-owned and serves the Northeast Kingdom of Vermont and northern New Hampshire from its St. Johnsbury base.

The company operates as a wholesale and retail distributor of plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies. Its St. Johnsbury facility functions as both a warehouse and a hardware store, staffed by nine employees who collectively hold over 100 years of industry experience. The product range spans pipe, fittings, fixtures, heating equipment, radiant-heating components, and electrical materials, with the company positioning radiant heating as a specialty.

Appalachian Supply serves plumbing, heating, and electrical contractors as well as residential and commercial property owners across its service territory. Customers include trade professionals who rely on the warehouse for job-site materials and walk-in retail buyers seeking hardware and repair parts. The company emphasizes its ability to source hard-to-find items, summarizing its approach with the slogan “If We Can’t Get It – You Don’t Need It.”

Differentiators highlighted by the company include free quotes, heating-system design assistance, and a focus on radiant-heating solutions. These services are offered alongside standard wholesale and retail supply, aiming to provide technical support that goes beyond simple product fulfillment.
